with Swift

Objective Domains
Earning the App Development with Swift Associate certification demonstrates knowledge of key computing
concepts and a solid foundation in programming with Swift and SwiftUI. They’ll demonstrate knowledge of the
impact of computing and apps on society, economies, and cultures while exploring app development.
